context: The current main-branch XRP signal history and evaluator were fully inspected. The legacy 45.5% metric is reproducible but not comparable prediction skill. Provider failures, stale signals, missing emission prices, variable horizons and overlapping records invalidate directional performance claims.
decisions: Preserve the legacy 1,697/772/45.5% metric as historical data, label it NOT_COMPARABLE, and never present it as calibrated or out-of-sample model accuracy.
Create immutable prediction events and separate immutable outcome events; never rewrite the original prediction record when an outcome becomes available.

Every prediction must record exact UTC data cutoff, emission time, horizon, target, assumptions, model/version, feature snapshot SHA, source IDs, price source, price timestamp, probability distribution, confidence/calibration version, alternatives and later outcome reference.
Use fixed evaluation horizons of 1h, 4h, 24h, 72h and 7d with explicit target definitions; no minimum-age/current-price shortcut.
Use a timestamped venue composite or documented reference-price methodology for both emission and outcome; record venue, quote type, exact timestamp, spread and source provenance.
Require probabilities for mutually exclusive outcomes (up/flat/down) that sum to one; do not treat an LLM's uncalibrated confidence scalar as probability.

Provider credential failure, HTTP 429, stale source data, missing price, or missing feature snapshot must produce NOT_EVALUATED and suppress directional forecasts; never substitute a neutral score such as 44.
Separate directional labels from neutral/low-volatility outcomes; do not combine a <2% neutral-band rule with directional hit rates.
Use chronological walk-forward splits, purge/embargo overlapping horizons, and compare with always-up, always-down, zero-return, drift and momentum baselines.
Evaluate Brier score, log loss, calibration slope/intercept, reliability bins/ECE, balanced accuracy and uncertainty by horizon and regime; report confidence intervals and drift.
Do not admit features or issue forecasts until point-in-time leakage checks, baseline comparisons, calibration and shadow/paper evaluation pass.
Keep the current accuracy workflow read-only; PR #1386 is the tested remediation but remains draft/unmerged. No main write or merge is authorized in this run.
invariants: Forecasts require a fixed horizon and explicit target.
Prediction records are immutable; outcomes are separate append-only records.
Missing provider or price data means NOT_EVALUATED, not neutral.
Company-reported and market observations retain source provenance and timestamp.
No real-money use before shadow/paper validation and explicit authorization.
Legacy accuracy is descriptive only and NOT_COMPARABLE.
No forecast is issued from the current stale/provider-failed signal.
